findings.title: GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in .map() without a `key`
findings.body: The previous `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} .../>` became `<GrafanaRuleListItem .../>` and the `key` prop was dropped. The `datasource` and default branches still pass `key={key}`. Siblings without keys in a mapped list trigger React's missing-key warning. They also break reconciliation as the list grows via infinite scroll and `startTransition` updates, so per-item state can attach to the wrong row. That state includes the delete modal, silence drawer and clone redirect held in `RuleActionsButtons`. Add `key={key}`.

findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items can never appear in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: The new list view passes only `promRule` and no `rulerRule`. `canPause` and `canDelete` are computed from the prom abilities, but rendering is still gated on the ruler rule. Pause requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). Delete requires `canDelete && rulerRule` (line 165). With only a prom rule, both items are silently hidden even when the user holds the permissions. The new `GrafanaGroupLoader` test grants `AlertingRuleDelete` yet asserts only four menu items (silence, copy link, duplicate, export), which confirms delete is gone. Users lose the ability to delete or pause Grafana rules from the list. `handleDelete` and `MenuItemPauseRule` need to work from a prom rule or identifier, or the gating needs to be reworked.

findings.title: 'Silence notifications' menu item does nothing in the list view
findings.body: The silence drawer is only mounted when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. In the list view `rule` is undefined because only `promRule` is passed. `AlertRuleMenu` still shows 'Silence notifications' via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` and its `onClick` sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true. Nothing renders, so the menu action silently does nothing. The drawer needs to be supported with a prom rule, or the menu item hidden when no ruler rule is available.

findings.title: Federated rule group check dropped from the legacy useAllAlertRuleAbilities path
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO. The legacy list, RulesTable and `RuleActionsButtons` v1 still use this hook. Rules in federated (`source_tenants`) groups are therefore no longer treated as immutable, and Edit/Delete/Pause become available for them. The deprecated wrapper should keep the federation check, or the `CombinedRule.group` should be passed through.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose Export (and Pause/Restore) abilities in the prom-based path
findings.body: The ruler-based hook uses `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule`, which is true for both alerting and recording Grafana rules, for `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore` and `DeletePermanently`. The new prom-based hook uses `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` for these. Recording rules lose Export in the new list view, and Pause/Restore/DeletePermanently are inconsistent with the ruler path. The comment says all rules are Grafana-managed 'by definition', which suggests a `grafana.rule` check was intended. Only Silence should be restricted to alerting rules.

findings.title: returnTo parameter dropped from the rule view link
findings.body: The old `GrafanaRuleListItem` built the href with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`. The new component links to `/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view` with no `returnTo`. After opening a rule from the list, the view page can no longer navigate back to the current list or filter state. It is also inconsistent with the other list item types. This looks accidental, since the rest of the change is about removing ruler requests.

findings.title: Tests encode the missing Delete item and miss the broken Silence flow
findings.body: The test grants `AlertingRuleDelete` and `AlertingRuleUpdate` but asserts exactly four menu items with no Delete. That locks in the regression where Delete and Pause are unreachable from the list view. No test clicks 'Silence notifications' and checks that the drawer opens, which would have caught the dead action. The old creating/deleting-state tests and `matchRules` tests were removed with the feature. The RulesTable RBAC tests still use rules that carry both `rulerRule` and `promRule`, so they do not exercise a prom-only rule.

findings.title: Stale doc comments still mention the Ruler endpoint
findings.body: The component doc says it 'Loads an evaluation group from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints', and the `expectedRulesCount` doc says 'Ruler response might contain different number of rules'. The component no longer calls the Ruler API. Update both comments to avoid misleading future readers.

findings.title: Comment and variable name still refer to ruler preload that was removed
findings.body: The ruler-group prefetch was deleted, but the comment 'This is not mandatory to preload ruler rules, but it improves the UX' and the variable name `cacheAndRulerPreload` remain. The block now only upserts the Prometheus cache. Rename the variable and fix the comment.
